  have : ∃ n, |x| ≤ n • |y| := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.1 hxy (by simp [ne_zero])
  rcases this with ⟨n, hn⟩
  use n

· intro H
  have : ∃ n, |y| ≤ n • |x| := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk.1 (by simp [h, H])
  rcases this with ⟨n, hn⟩
  use n
  · exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).1
  · rw [mul_comm]
    exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).2
